description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'ContextualToolbarModelView' for managing the contextual toolbar UI in a Drupal module, including event handling, rendering, and accessibility features.

classes.name: ContextualToolbarModelView
classes.description: A class managing the state and behavior of the contextual toolbar in Drupal, including visibility, locking links, tabbing constraints, and accessibility announcements.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the toolbar view, sets up event listeners, and renders the initial state.

methods.name: onKeypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events for accessibility, including tab and escape keys.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the toolbar's DOM elements based on current state.

methods.name: updateVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility of the toolbar based on the number of contextual links.

methods.name: lockNewContextualLinks
methods.description: Locks or unlocks newly added contextual links depending on edit mode.

methods.name: manageTabbing
methods.description: Constrains or releases tabbing within the toolbar for accessibility.

methods.name: announceTabbingConstraint
methods.description: Announces the tabbing constraint status for accessibility.

methods.name: get isViewing
methods.description: Getter for the current viewing state.

methods.name: set isViewing
methods.description: Setter for the current viewing state, updates local storage and link locking.

methods.name: get contextualCount
methods.description: Getter for the count of contextual links.

methods.name: set contextualCount
methods.description: Setter for the count of contextual links, triggers visibility update.
